proof_requirements.statement: Show shared failure-domain identities are rejected.
Show one protection operation writes and verifies the same object identity in all layers.
Show operational loss recovers from the journal and verifies the destination.
Show operational and journal loss recovers from the immutable archive.
Show corrupt candidates never produce restoration success.
Show an existing archive identity cannot be overwritten with changed bytes.
Show core orchestration depends only on database-neutral ports.
Show independent PostgreSQL operational and journal services satisfy their adapter contracts.
Show recovery evidence binds source, destination, policy, object set, and observation.
